metadata.title: ai-local-model-ops - Sources
metadata.description: Local and self-hosted LLM runtime references for July 2026: local execution, self-hosted chat UIs, Apple Silicon / MLX, desktop runtimes, portable packaging, lightweight adaptation, and local optimization levers.

runtime_and_ui.name: Ollama
runtime_and_ui.description: Reference runtime for local model execution and simple self-hosted workflows.

runtime_and_ui.name: Open WebUI
runtime_and_ui.description: Self-hosted ChatGPT-like interface for local and private model usage.

runtime_and_ui.name: LM Studio
runtime_and_ui.description: Cross-platform desktop GUI runtime with in-app HuggingFace model browser. Supports GGUF and MLX model formats; targets non-technical users and rapid model comparisons.

runtime_and_ui.name: Microsoft Foundry Local
runtime_and_ui.description: Microsoft-managed local runtime with curated model catalog and SDK-first API. Windows / enterprise-adjacent developer workflows.

runtime_and_ui.name: simonw/llm
runtime_and_ui.description: Lightweight CLI for local and remote model experimentation and comparison.

apple_silicon.name: MLX (mlx-lm)
apple_silicon.description: Apple's ML framework for Apple Silicon. Primary path for on-device inference, LoRA fine-tuning, and custom generation pipelines targeting Metal. Supports quantization natively.

packaging_and_adaptation.name: LlamaFile
packaging_and_adaptation.description: Portable single-executable packaging for local model delivery.

packaging_and_adaptation.name: Unsloth
packaging_and_adaptation.description: Lightweight adaptation and fine-tuning workflows on constrained hardware.

optimization_and_serving.name: vLLM V1 Guide
optimization_and_serving.description: vLLM V1 engine documentation. V0 is fully deprecated. Covers speculative decoding, KV-cache quantization, and FP8 serving.

optimization_and_serving.name: llama.cpp
optimization_and_serving.description: Reference GGUF inference engine underpinning Ollama and LM Studio. Source of truth for KV-cache quantization flags, speculative decoding options, and Apple Silicon Metal support.

small_models.name: HuggingFace Model Hub
small_models.description: Primary source for current Gemma, Phi, and Qwen model releases and version tags. Always verify point-release availability here before recommending a specific version to users.

small_models.name: Gemma Releases Page
small_models.description: Official Google Gemma release notes. Current as of June 2026: Gemma 4 12B (April 2, 2026, Apache 2.0, encoder-free multimodal), QAT weights (June 5, 2026, ~72% memory reduction). Verify exact weights and context window before recommending.

small_models.name: Ollama Releases
small_models.description: Official Ollama release notes. Stable was v0.30.10 (June 17, 2026) as of this validation, with pre-releases moving faster; the repo now advertises Kimi-K2, GLM, MiniMax, DeepSeek, gpt-oss, Qwen, and Gemma support in its own README. Includes `ollama launch` capability for launching integrated tools and companion applications (e.g., `ollama launch hermes-desktop`, `ollama launch codex`) — confirmed current as of July 2026. Verify current version before quoting.

small_models.name: DeepSeek (Hugging Face org)
small_models.description: Primary source for current DeepSeek V3.x/R1 releases and R1-Distill-* small models. MIT-licensed as of the V3.2/R1 line. Full V3/R1-class MoE (~671-675B total params) does not fit on a single consumer GPU or single H100 at usable quant; only the distills are laptop/workstation-class. Verify current release and license before quoting.

small_models.name: Mistral AI News
small_models.description: Primary source for Mistral 3 / Ministral (3B/8B/14B dense, Apache 2.0) and Mistral Large 3 (675B total / 41B active MoE, Dec 2025) releases. Verify current sizes, license, and context window before quoting.
